# Email Workflows

## Use when
The user asks to find, summarize, organize, or draft email.

## Workflow
- Search narrowly using sender, subject, date, or topic when available.
- Summarize only relevant messages and preserve dates and sender context.
- Draft replies for review; do not send unless the user explicitly asks to send the exact message.
- Do not delete, archive, label, forward, or alter messages without explicit approval.
- Never expose sensitive legal, medical, financial, family, or identity details in public project documentation.
- Never place passwords, OAuth tokens, or recovery codes in messages or repository files.

## Reporting
Distinguish a draft from a sent email and a search result from a complete mailbox review.
